comparison.objective: Break four small metal tangs and recover them; record flexes a build plate to release a printed part and bins it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate regulates localized hammer impact through a coaxial mandrel; record applies coordinated bilateral bending while avoiding permanent plate kinking.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four notch fractures and four contained fragments without coil/shell damage; record requires release by symmetric flex, part in bin, plate restored flat, and no overbend. Candidate fracture/damage thresholds remain unspecified.
comparison.reason: Both release attached material, but distributed elastic flex release tests a different ability from localized impact-driven fracture.
